items.title: उपाधि रक्षाको यात्रामा साविक विजेता लुम्बिनीले पाएको मोमेन्टम
items.summary: तेस्रो संस्करणमा लुम्बिनीले सुरुवातदेखि नै आफूलाई उपाधि दाबेदारका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिरहेको छ। लगातार राम्रो नतिजा निकाल्दै सबैभन्दा पहिले प्लेअफमा पुग्नु त्यसकै प्रमाण हो।

items.title: त्रिवि क्रिकेट मैदानमा एनपीएलले दिएको खुसी (तस्बिरहरू)
items.summary: त्रिवि क्रिकेट मैदानमा जारी खेल हेर्न आज पनि ठूलो संख्यामा दर्शक पुगेका छन् ।

items.title: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघका महासचिव र परराष्ट्रमन्त्रीबीच भेटवार्ता

items.title: अनिँदो र थकानमा थिए चालक, प्रहरी चेकपोस्टमा थिएन इन्ट्री
items.summary: बुधबार सर्लाहीबाट काठमाडौं आएका चालक पर्याप्त आराम नलिँदै, अनिँदो अवस्थामै मध्यराति यात्रु संकलन गरी हिँडेका थिए ।

items.title: न रोकिए घातक दुर्घटना, न ब्युँझिए शासक-प्रशासक
items.summary: विज्ञका अनुसार नीति, नियम वा कानुन अभावले नभई सडक सुरक्षाको जिम्मेवारी पाएका सरकारी अधिकारीहरू गम्भीर बन्न नसक्दा घातक सडक दुर्घटनाको शृङ्खला न्यूनीकरण हुन नसकेको हो ।

items.title: मुख्य ठेकेदार सम्पर्कविहीन, करेन्ट लागेका मजदुर बर्न अस्पतालमै अलपत्र

items.title: लुम्बिनी बन्यो प्लेअफ पुग्ने पहिलो टिम, कर्णालीको लगातार चौथो हार

items.title: Nepal still has few large employers after 35 years of liberalisation
items.summary: Around 500,000 young people enter the labour market every year, but only a handful of business groups employ more than 10,000 people each.

items.title: Lumbini Lions seal playoff spot as Karnali Yaks suffer fourth straight defeat
items.summary: The defending champions climbed to the top of the Nepal Premier League standings with a six-wicket win, while Karnali’s hopes of reaching the playoffs suffered another setback.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in big blow to AI boom
items.summary: Huang, who co-founded Nvidia and is its fourth-largest investor ‌with a stake of about 3.61 percent, will exit the board as well.

items.title: RSP delegation to visit China at Communist Party’s invitation
items.summary: The 20-member team, led by General Secretary Bipin Kumar Acharya, will hold discussions on governance, economic development and political cooperation during its visit from November 15.

items.title: Captain change fails to revive Karnali Yaks
items.summary: David Miller took over from Sompal Kami, but Karnali were bowled out for 105 against Lumbini Lions, leaving their playoff hopes hanging by a thread.

items.title: Madhesh chief minister to seek confidence vote on November 14
items.summary: Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav is seeking a vote of confidence after the CPN-UML and Nepali Communist Party, both members of his coalition government, withdrew their support.

items.title: Congo Ebola outbreak still out of control after six months, MSF says
items.summary: With the number of confirmed cases now surpassing 11,000, the outbreak is the second-worst on record.

items.title: Lamichhane’s record six-wicket haul keeps Biratnagar’s playoff hopes alive
items.summary: The Biratnagar Kings captain took the first hat-trick of NPL Season 3 to bowl out Pokhara Avengers for 132 before his side chased down the target with four wickets to spare.

items.title: 11 of 13 killed in Makawanpur microbus crash identified
items.summary: The electric minibus was travelling from Kathmandu to Sarlahi when it plunged off the road at Chisapanigadhi along the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani-Kathmandu road section at around 5:45 am on Thursday.

items.title: Lamichhane takes NPL’s first hat-trick and six-wicket haul as Pokhara set 133-run target
items.summary: The leg-spinner dismisses five batters in a decisive spell, including Yuvraj Samra, who had struck 84 off 47 balls, to leave Biratnagar Kings chasing 133 against Pokhara Avengers.

items.title: कर्णालीको कमजोर ब्याटिङ र प्लेअफ सम्भावनाबारे के भने गुल्सनले?

items.title: चीन र भारतका टायल्ससँग नेपाली उद्योगले कसरी प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्दैछ?
